title: Backup Vault
summary: A reinforced chamber lined with redundant cooling units and a single access console. The air hums with static, and a faint blue glow pulses from a terminal.
arrival_narration: The northward door hisses shut behind you. A thick, insulated wall blocks any sound from the aisles beyond. Your boots crunch on a thin layer of static-clinging dust. A **cooling unit** vents warm air, its fan whirring unevenly. A **terminal** mounted on the wall displays a single line: *AUTHORIZATION REQUIRED*. To your left, a **metal hatch** is bolted to the floor, its edges warped. A **wall-mounted badge reader** sits idle beside a **sealed data crate** stamped with a faded red triangle.

spatial_anomalies: cooling unit emits faint electrical crackle
floor hatch shows signs of forced entry
